title: Pick and Place Sequencer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Read the eight steps of a pick-and-place task, each with the reason it comes where it does. Then put eight shuffled step cards into the right order, with three attempts to get them all in place. Used in Chapter 11.

educational.topic: The order of the steps in a pick-and-place task
learningObjectives: Organize the eight steps of a pick-and-place task into their correct order, with at least 7 of the 8 steps in their correct positions within three attempts

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Order shuffled procedure cards by their dependencies, with a count of correct positions after each attempt and the reasons revealed at the end
keyQuestions: Which step must happen before the gripper closes?
Which moves are straight up or straight down, and why?
commonMisconceptions: The arm should go straight to the object's height from home
The gripper closes at the same time as the arm descends
The arm can move away as soon as the gripper opens
assessmentOpportunities: One ordering exercise with up to three checked attempts; mastery is 7 or more of 8 cards in the correct position

controls.label: Tap a card to select it
